dishes.name: False Chicken Mushroom
dishes.description:
Description: Fresh button & oyster mushrooms marinated in thick curd, aromatic Indian spices, ginger-garlic paste and a hint of lemon. Cooked until golden and juicy, offering a deliciously spicy, tangy and creamy flavour.

Ingredients: Button & Oyster mushrooms, thick curd, ginger-garlic paste, red chilli powder, turmeric, garam masala, cumin powder, coriander powder, salt, lemon juice and mustard oil.
